description.en: CLIProxyAPI with an optional Cloudflare Tunnel.
description.zh-CN: 带可选 Cloudflare Tunnel 的 CLIProxyAPI。

apps.compose:
services:
  cli-proxy-api:
    image: eceasy/cli-proxy-api@sha256:3f7a734784f4cc2c86f6268929caff1b0c178fe600fdaa12cefe884dc4cae841
    restart: unless-stopped
    read_only: true
    environment:
      TZ: ${timezone}
    ports:
      - 127.0.0.1:8317:8317
    volumes:
      - ./config.yaml:/CLIProxyAPI/config.yaml:ro
      - ./auths:/root/.cli-proxy-api
      - ./logs:/CLIProxyAPI/logs
      - ./plugins:/CLIProxyAPI/plugins
  cloudflared-cpa:
    profiles: [cloudflare-tunnel]
    image: cloudflare/cloudflared:2026.7.2@sha256:4f6655284ab3d252b7f28fedb19fe6c8fc82ee5b1295c20ac74d475e5398a52d
    command: tunnel --no-autoupdate run --token-file /run/secrets/tunnel_token
    volumes:
      - ./secrets/tunnel_token:/run/secrets/tunnel_token:ro
